Ta có: $0 < x < 45$.\\
		Chi phí: $C(x) = 10 + C_v = 10 + 3S^2 = 10 + 3\left(\sqrt{45-x}\right)^2 = 145 - 3x$ (tỷ đồng).\\
		Doanh thu: $D(x) = x\sqrt{45-x}$.\\
		Lợi nhuận: $L(x) = D(x) - C(x) = x\sqrt{45-x} + 3x - 145$.\\
		Ta có: $L'(x) = \displaystyle\frac{90 - 3x + 6\sqrt{45-x}}{2\sqrt{45-x}}$.\\
		Cho $L'(x) = 0 \Rightarrow \displaystyle\frac{90 - 3x + 6\sqrt{45-x}}{2\sqrt{45-x}} = 0 \Rightarrow 90 - 3x + 6\sqrt{45-x} = 0$\\
		$\Rightarrow 3x - 90 = 6\sqrt{45-x} \Rightarrow \left\{\begin{aligned}&x \geq 30\\&x = 20 \text{ (loại)} \vee x = 36\end{aligned}\right. \Leftrightarrow x = 36$.
